evals.prompt: meeting prep for my call with <account-slug> tomorrow
evals.expected_behavior: Reads calendar, pulls attendee profiles, Backstory signals, account context, produces brief
assertions: Gets tomorrow's calendar events via gws calendar
Calls Backstory for <account-slug> account signals
Runs fieldkit contact find for each external attendee
Produces a meeting brief with agenda, questions, and talking points

evals.expected_behavior: Focuses on the pursuit, reads exact native ClosePlan questions, and surfaces question-level evidence needs while preserving pending/unavailable states
assertions: Reads the {{primary_pursuit}} pursuit file for {{primary_account}}
Uses the exact Salesforce Opportunity and ClosePlan deal identity rather than historical local scores
Surfaces exact native question IDs and wording as questions to ask
Reports ambiguous metadata as pending and missing or failed reads as unavailable

evals.expected_behavior: Scans tomorrow's calendar, identifies external meetings via domain matching, auto-generates prep briefs for each
assertions: Gets tomorrow's calendar events via gws calendar
Filters to external meetings only (non-internal-domain attendees)
Matches attendee domains to configured accounts from accounts.yaml
Generates prep brief for each matched external meeting
Outputs a summary table of all events with brief status
